selection_population: tuning participants only, starting waves 1 through 6
missing_answer_policy: All optional model questions permit don't know, prefer not to answer, and not applicable/not previously asked; encode null plus distinct reason, never zero. No invented historical responses or fixed imputation values. Later preprocessing learns from tuning training folds only.

decisions.app: Eleven understandable baseline inputs; exclude the historically carried sex/gender category, sparse regular-smoking histories, nominal-US income, detailed product inventories, diagnostic recency and conditional alcohol quantities. Recency and household retain routing/distribution-shift caveats.
decisions.minimal: Three basic demographics plus observed quit/last-cigarette recency; no reconstruction or missing-as-zero.
decisions.research: Preserve the 25-candidate survey-available set as a separate research comparison, including conditional history. This is a fixed research profile, not an app model and not an outcome-ranked feature selection. Its performance and incremental utility remain unknown.
